notes: Guides are Leonida Ledger's own words. Each step names the public source its facts come from; nothing is copied.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlocks by itself once the other 54 trophies are earned; the whole list is single-player, with no online or DLC trophy. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Earn the other 54. None of them needs GTA Online or DLC, so one single-player save carries the whole list.
Budget roughly 200 hours; PowerPyx rates the list about 4 out of 10 for difficulty and says one playthrough is enough.
Cheats switch off trophies and saving for that session, so keep them off for the whole run.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic: it pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Gone Fishing opens Chapter 1. Finish it and the trophy unlocks on its own; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic: it lands after What's in the Bag?, the first mission of Chapter 2. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: The Chapter 1 trophy does not pop at the chapter's last mission; it arrives once you clear What's in the Bag?, the opener of Chapter 2.
Before leaving Chapter 1, take Lucia up on the balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic: it lands after Welcome to Vice City, the first mission of Chapter 3. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Play on into Chapter 3; clearing its first mission, Welcome to Vice City, awards the Chapter 2 trophy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic: it lands after Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two missions of Chapter 4. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: The Chapter 3 trophy waits until you have cleared both Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic: Starting From Zero, the last mission of Chapter 4, awards it. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Starting From Zero closes Chapter 4; finishing it gives this trophy straight away.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold for the campaign's last mission. Free roam goes on afterwards, but missions cannot be replayed, so keep a manual save first. Sources: PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.

steps.text: Finish the last story mission of Chapter 5 for the gold.
You keep playing in free roam after the credits, but no mission can be replayed; make a separate manual save before the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission. Source: PowerPyx walkthrough.

steps.text: Breakfast Run comes up in the Chapter 2 story; complete it and Trust unlocks.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 story through The Cartel Heist; the trophy follows on its own.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic: Child's Play is part of the Chapter 4 story. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission; clear it to unlock Family Matters.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic: Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Headliners sits in the Chapter 4 story; finishing it awards DWNFALL.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic: VCIA Takedown comes up during Chapter 4. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission; it gives the trophy when you finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Operation Savage Glory arrives in Chapter 5; clear it and Snow Storm unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Work through the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats; it is lenient (about 60% of everything) and stays open in free roam. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: After the story, open Progress > Stats for the 100% checklist. What you did earlier already counts, and all of it can be finished in free roam.
It is lighter than it sounds: most side quests are not on it, and collectibles are only partly required, such as 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned and 70 of 80 challenges.
The parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any mix of stunt jumps, bridge and knife flights and base jumps counts; the 100% list wants 300, so this comes on the way. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights between buildings and base jumps all add to one total of 250.
The 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, so chase that and this silver unlocks on the way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Start each of the nine activity types once; Progress > Activities shows which you still lack. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: There are nine activity types. Playing one of each, win or lose, is the whole requirement.
Progress > Activities lists every category with your count, so the missing type is easy to spot.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges; the PS5 tracker counts each gold. Sources: PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.

steps.text: The trophy tracker climbs to 42, one gold for each shooting range challenge.
PowerPyx calls the range golds manageable, and they are on the 100% checklist too, so none can be skipped.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Source: PSNProfiles.

steps.text: There are 14 drone race locations; one win at each fills the tracker. Drone races are also required in full for 100%.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races; winning the same race twice adds nothing. Source: PSNProfiles.

steps.text: Only first wins in different races count toward the 20, so move on after each victory.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in Feng Shui, follow his text to the purple fishing marker and win his challenge. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Cal texts you once you have met him in the mission Feng Shui, and a purple fishing marker appears.
Follow that questline until his fishing challenge and beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Clear every level of any one of the four arcade games; its bonus challenges are optional. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Pick one of the four playable arcade cabinets and beat all of its levels. The extra challenges inside the game are not needed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia's; its finale, Puff Puff Pass, gives the trophy. Source: PowerPyx walkthrough.

steps.text: Play Andy's missions as Lucia through to the last one, Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's diving strand starts in Chapter 1; recover the treasure from the purple chest markers and bring it to him. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Kenton shows up as early as Chapter 1 with a diving questline.
Dive to the purple chest markers, recover the treasure and hand it back to him to close the strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand ends with Hometown Heroes, which awards it. Source: PowerPyx walkthrough.

steps.text: Follow Billy's missions to the finale, Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight whole stranger strands; the tracker counts strands, not single missions. Source: PSNProfiles.

steps.text: The counter goes up only when a stranger's whole questline ends, so finish strands before starting new ones.
Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own trophy, so their five strands are the obvious first picks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Fill Randy's Wish List of 16 vehicles, one of which you deliver in the Chapter 3 story. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List asks for 16 vehicles. The one you hand over during the Chapter 3 story counts as one of them.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends with Spin On This, where you shut the labs down. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Work through Tyrone's questline to its last mission, Spin On This, in which the labs get shut down.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable: Chapter 1 window: accept Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter ends. PowerPyx has not confirmed whether it is required.
trophies.guide: 18 meditation spots. The first is a Chapter 1 scene with Lucia that can be skipped, so take it. Sources: PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.

steps.text: After Down to Earth in Chapter 1, talk to Lucia in Jason's kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and say yes to meditating.
The PS5 tracker lists 18 meditation entries in all.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting invite arrives after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; his Target Decks stay open after the story. Which animal counts is not confirmed yet. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Jason gets Bret's hunting invitation once Coffee Break in Chapter 2 is done.
Bret's Target Decks remain available after the story. No source yet confirms which unique animal triggers the trophy, so work through his decks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Any three of the 18 card sets will do. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: PowerPyx counts 18 card sets; finish whichever three are easiest for you.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Open WAiNK on the phone and scan any mix of landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags until you reach 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Any 50 of the 80 challenges; 100% needs 70, so skip the hardest ten. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Choose any 50 of the 80 challenges for this trophy.
A Long Road wants 70, so you can still leave the ten hardest undone.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once partner free roam opens after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), get four stars with your partner along, then leave the red heat zone. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Free roam with your partner opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
With the partner in tow, raise a four-star Wanted Level, break line of sight and get out of the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: The flashing pursuit must stay on between shops, not just the red zone; if the first shop starts no chase, rob a fourth. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Keep the active, flashing pursuit going while you drive between shops; staying in the red zone alone is not enough.
If one robbery fails to start a chase, it may not count, so carry on to a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan new vehicles with WAiNK from the kerb; you never have to drive them. 100% needs 200, so this comes first. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Point WAiNK at vehicles you have not logged yet; scanning is enough, no need to get in.
The 100% checklist asks for 200 of 277 base models, so this unlocks halfway there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Use gang members as targets, and wait until Focus is upgraded. Police, soldiers and civilians may not count. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Upgrade the Focus stat first so one activation lasts long enough for five takedowns.
Fight gang enemies; PowerPyx reports that police, soldiers and civilians may not count toward the five.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge (E3/E4, for example) and fly about 1 km away; jets parked on the airfield do not count. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: At VCIA, find a passenger jet attached to a boarding bridge; gates E3 and E4 are one example.
Take off and fly roughly 1 km from the airport. Jets parked out on the airfield do not work.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Take a Rhino tank from the south end of Mile Zero Air Station (Mariana County) and defeat enemies from inside it. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: A Rhino waits at the south end of Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Climb in and take down enemies from the tank to unlock it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: Snap Gun the back door, open the safe with its code, wipe the footage and kill the alarm. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Unlock it by finishing Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first.
Pick a back door with the Snap Gun, use the safe's code, erase the camera footage and switch the alarm off, all unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Any five of the eight big bank jobs; hover a bank icon to see if its vault is done. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: There are eight large bank jobs; five vaults robbed and escaped is enough.
Hover over a bank's map icon to check whether you have already emptied its vault.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: A big bank vault job can count for this as well; it pops once you are out of the red heat zone. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Rob an armored truck, or a large bank vault job, which PowerPyx says can also satisfy it.
The trophy only unlocks after you escape the red heat zone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Lift the fog from the whole map (52 entries on the PS5 tracker); fly over the dark patches. Sources: PowerPyx, PSN 100%.

steps.text: Clear every patch of map fog. Flying over what is left is much quicker than driving.
The PS5 tracker counts 52 exploration entries.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One operation per gang, nine gangs; Progress > Gangs shows which are done. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: You need one robbed operation for each gang, not all of them.
Progress > Gangs lists how many you have hit per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Ride the lift past the Ocean View pool to the rooftop bar, buy a cocktail and drink it at the beach-side railing. Sources: Gamer Social Club, TrueAchievements.

steps.text: At Ocean View, take the lift beyond the pool up to the rooftop bar.
Order a cocktail and drink it standing at the railing that faces the beach.
An Apple Martini is reported to work.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Clone the key of the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, then drive it out through the glass. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: In the showroom in south Vice City, use the Key Cloner on the blue Banshee.
Drive that car straight through the window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn of its three key valuables: the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 and the safe. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: The alley is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 and whatever is in the safe.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max Strength on Jason and Lucia together; bring your partner to a fitness club so you both train at once. Source: HeistAtlas.

steps.text: Both characters need maxed Strength at the same time.
Take your partner to a fitness club: a joint session raises Strength for both.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable: From Chapter 1, choices are permanent: an Irredeemable Criminal Profile rating cannot be undone, so watch your profile from the first chapter.
trophies.guide: Anything that moves your Criminal Profile adds progress (the PS5 tracker counts to 500). Turn on profile notifications and stay out of Irredeemable, which is permanent. Sources: GTABase, PSN 100%.

steps.text: Actions that change your Criminal Profile build this trophy's progress; enable Criminal Profile notifications to see each change.
Avoid the Irredeemable rating, which GTABase says is permanent.
The PS5 tracker runs to 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: After Credit Check (Chapter 3), go back as Lucia alone to the prologue's Little Cuba Payday Loans, rob it again and escape on foot. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Wait until Credit Check in Chapter 3 is done.
As Lucia, without Jason, return to Payday Loans in Little Cuba from the prologue, rob it and get away on foot.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Alone, after 2 a.m., northwest of the Starlet Motel: follow the path from the blinking car to the UFO and walk the woman back. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Go solo some time after 2 a.m. to the area northwest of the Starlet Motel.
Follow the trail from the car with blinking lights to the UFO, then escort the woman you find back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians off a motorcycle inside 60 seconds; Ocean Beach is crowded enough. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Ride a motorcycle and use melee kicks on pedestrians: ten within 60 seconds.
Ocean Beach is one suggested spot for the crowds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Chapter 3) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer; marked bills turned in to fences add up across payouts. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: Clear Credit Check in Chapter 3 to get the Dye Pack Jammer.
Hand marked bills to fences; the $250,000 is cumulative across every payout.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Every shop purchase feeds one running total; you do not have to buy in every shop. Source: GAMES.GG.

steps.text: Purchases anywhere add to a single spending total of $100,000; one shop or many, it all counts.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the eight purchasable garages ($160,000 in all) in the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver (Chapter 2); story garages do not count. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: The Vice City Real Estate app arrives after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Buy all eight purchasable garages, about $160,000 together. The four story garages are not part of it.
Robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 pay well enough to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros opens after Moses (Chapter 2). Registering costs money and garage space, so register cheap cars and bikes after buying garages. Source: PowerPyx.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app installs after the Chapter 2 mission Moses.
Each registration costs cash and needs garage space, so buy garages first (Little Boxes) and register cheap cars or bikes.
